title: TH-HK2 · D
line: I am a doctor, and I am going to tell you to do something before you come and see me about your knee. It takes ten seconds and it is not a prescription.
notes: leans in a touch on 'before you come and see me'; one flat hand down on the desk on 'not a prescription' · ~155 wpm · L-D-CONS · D-D1 · eye/front/MCU · spine (under every B-roll) · EG01 · product: absent
